                                                    Notes (1) Parking will not be permitted along arterials and collectors, except on portions of collectors with a designated parking lane.




Standards & Guidelines (3rd Amendment)
                                                          (2) Adjacent property owners will be responsible for design and construction of sidewalk and landscape improvements north of College Drive and east of Loving Trail.
                                                          (3) Trail alignments may vary slightly from those illustrated in street sections because of grading, utilities, and other constraints.
                                                          (4) Optional Median may be raised w/curb & gutter, depressed for drainage, or no median.
                                                          (5) a) If an attached sidewalk is allowed via subdivision waiver, then a minimum 6’ wide sidewalk is required (8’ @ Collector & Arterial). b) sidewalk both sides optional
                                                          (6) “Rural” areas defined as any LDR/VLDR area having lot frontage ≥85 feet and total density of less than 2 DU/acre (See Section 4, Table 4), exclusive of Open Space.
                                                          (7) Where Regional Trail (H) is present, sidewalk (G) is optional where noted.
                                                          (8) A 4" white stripe shall be required on both edge of traveled ways.
